Priya Raman: Heads-up: found a misleading example in the API ref for POST /v1/generate. The cURL and Node snippets show `temperature: 50` (percent style) but the runtime now expects a float 0.0-1.0. Sending 50 leads to clamps or errors in some SDKs.

Ethan Cole: Oh wow, where did that come from? I thought we migrated examples last year. Can you paste the snippet?

Priya Raman: Current curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","prompt":"Summarize this","temperature":50}'
```
This was from older docs where we used 0-100. Newer servers expect 0.5 for 50%.

Marta López: Good catch. That will surprise customers. We should: fix all examples, add a short migration note, and add a unit note near the param: "temperature is a float in [0.0,1.0] (0.5 = 50%)".

Ethan Cole: I'll open a docs PR to update cURL, Node, Ruby snippets and add the migration blurb. Also add an example line showing conversion: `50 -> 0.5` to reduce confusion.

Priya Raman: Recommend also running a quick grep across docs for `"temperature":\s*\d{1,3}` to catch any other integer-percent instances.

Ethan Cole: Doing that now. Found 4 occurrences in examples and one in a legacy tutorial. I'll update examples and leave the legacy tutorial with a clear migration callout.

docs-bot: PR created by ethan-cole: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1407 	 title: "docs(generate): normalize temperature to 0.0-1.0 in examples, add migration note"

Marta López: Quick copy nit: use "older examples" instead of "legacy" and format the conversion snippet in monospace. Also add a short console test in docs CI to run the updated curl and validate 2xx.

Ethan Cole: Updated per nit, added CI curl smoke, and included a one-line param note: "temperature: float between 0.0 and 1.0 (use 0.5 for 50%)." Ran updated curl against staging, got 200 and expected token sample.

deploy-bot: docs staging deploy queued: docs-site/docs@staging build #9021

Marta López: Merged to staging. I'll do a quick pass and then to main. Good catch Priya.

Priya Raman: Thanks. Filed ENG follow-up to add a linter rule that flags integer temps in docs examples (ENG-1188). Closing thread after main deploy. :thumbsup:
